stem: Checkout conversion was 4.0% in control and 5.0% in treatment. A slide says "Conversion up 1%". Which correction is accurate?

options.text: Up 1%, since 1 percentage point and 1 percent are the same thing
Up 20% relative, since the lift is 1 point out of the 5.0% rate
Up 0.25 percentage points, since the lift is 1 divided by 4
Up 1 percentage point, which is a 25% relative lift
